governance.attested_by: ercot 22 cc-coal-rebalance-v2: moderate CC/coal offer-curve deltas from run157 keeper 2026-06-30
governance.note: ercot 22 = run157 keeper recipe (ercot_run157_damas2024) + reliability_floor + moderated CC/coal deltas. Starting from the run157 structural keeper (zonal gas, oil-primary, West net-load gas shape, storage-AS commitment, curve smoothing 0.35, DAM-AS overlay, RTORDPA, measured F923/Henry-Hub fuel prices, EIA-860 BTM CHP host steam, coal PRB passthrough sigmoid, per-plant CAMPD binning), three offer-curve deltas are moderated from ercot 21 to fix the 2023 LMP collapse ($28.57 vs $48.36 actual) caused by ercot 21 making CC too cheap at 2023's $2.54/MWh gas: (1) CC_REGULAR econ_high delta -0.10 (keeper -0.20, ercot 21 0.0) — halfway, CC economic tranche cheaper than keeper but not as aggressive as ercot 21; (2) CC_REGULAR peak delta +0.25 (keeper +0.32, ercot 21 +0.18) — moderates duct-firing discount; (3) PRB sigmoid floor 0.76 (keeper 0.78, ercot 21 0.74) — moderate coal bid aggressiveness. All three levers are offer-curve shape parameters with no fit to price residuals — they adjust where CC and coal sit in the merit order relative to gas price. reliability_floor=True carried from ercot 21 (temperature/net-load-driven commitment floors from the CAMPD-derived coefficient CSVs). No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no adder/haircut tuned to price or volume residuals.

exceptions.reason: C3a price-LEVEL (soft). Model 2024 load-wtd mean vs actual $26.83 = +8.5%, just over the ±8% band. This is inherited from the run157 keeper recipe (+9.0% on same year); the moderate CC/coal delta adjustment slightly improves it. The residual is the known energy-only-dual limitation (LP duals structurally under-shoot true market LMP which carries reserve/scarcity/uplift adders). Per non-negotiable rule #1 no adder applied to close the gap.
